guidelines.title: labels top aligned by default
guidelines.rule: Labels top-aligned by default; left-align only if space is tight and fields are consistent type/width.
pass_when: Labels sit above fields; left-aligned labels only when space is tight and fields share type/width.
fail_when: Left-aligned labels on mixed-type/width fields, or as the default when space is not tight.
guidelines.do_not_claim: GOV.UK above-the-control as a merge of sentence-case/colons. Overlap with Forms 54: beyond LIVE `visible_label` / `label_stays_visible`.

guidelines.title: required asterisk or one instruction
guidelines.rule: Required: red asterisk via required prop; if all fields required, one instruction — not an asterisk on every field; two-field sign-in may omit.
pass_when: Mixed required/optional uses the required asterisk. All-required uses one instruction, not an asterisk on every field. Two-field sign-in may omit.
fail_when: Asterisk on every field of an all-required form (beyond the two-field sign-in omit), or required unmarked in a mixed form.
guidelines.do_not_claim: NN/g mark-optional (`forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`) as a winner. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`.

guidelines.title: disabled field label stays perceivable
guidelines.rule: Disabled field: control disabled; label (and helper/validation) stay enabled so AT can still perceive them. Settings Save MAY disable until requireds are complete only with visible reason + this perceivable label (dual-cite with GOV.UK don’t-disable on public/question).
pass_when: Disabled control still has a perceivable (not disabled-away) label and helper/validation. If Settings Save is disabled, the reason is visible and the label stays perceivable.
fail_when: Disabled control whose label/helper/validation cannot be perceived; or disabled Save with no visible reason.

guidelines.title: helper text below
guidelines.rule: Helper text below for format/accepted values; bullets if several sentences; skip the period on helper and placeholder.
pass_when: Format/accepted-values helper sits below; several sentences use bullets; helper/placeholder omit the period.
fail_when: Helper above/missing for needed format; several sentences as one block with end periods.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Placeholder as the only label (skipped; Forms lock). GOV.UK item-hint no full stops is a sibling, not a merge.

guidelines.title: validation messages brief no end punctuation
guidelines.rule: Validation messages brief; no end punctuation unless multiple sentences.
pass_when: Brief validation; no end punctuation on a single sentence; punctuation only if multiple sentences.
fail_when: Single-sentence validation with a trailing period, or long un-brief validation.

guidelines.title: create labels new thing
guidelines.rule: Create labels: “New {thing}”; menu trigger “New”; menu items drop the word New.
pass_when: Create action is “New {thing}”; the menu trigger is “New”; items inside drop New.
fail_when: Menu items repeat New, or the create control is unlabeled / generic Add with no New pattern where this usage applies.
guidelines.do_not_claim: NN/g verb-leading as a merge. Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.copy.verbs_for_actions`.

guidelines.title: split button dont repeat primary
guidelines.rule: Split button: full phrase on the rest-state primary; don’t repeat that primary in the secondary list.
pass_when: Rest-state primary has the full phrase; the secondary list does not repeat that primary.
fail_when: Primary phrase is incomplete, or the same primary is duplicated in the list.

guidelines.title: multistep next not continue
guidelines.rule: Multistep: Next not Continue; Previous not Back. Dual-cite with GOV.UK question-page Continue / Back — by surface, not a winner.
pass_when: Multistep settings/wizard uses Next and Previous. Question pages still use Continue and Back (GOV.UK).
fail_when: Multistep uses Continue/Back as this Fluent usage; or a global Next/Continue winner applied to the other surface.
guidelines.do_not_claim: NN/g prefer specific verb over generic Next as a winner that bans Next here. Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.copy.verbs_for_actions` (prefer specific verb over generic Next) and GOV.UK question-page Continue.

guidelines.title: end of task labels named
guidelines.rule: End-of-task labels named: Done, Finish, Close, Got it, Dismiss (pick the one that matches the outcome).
pass_when: End-of-task uses one of Done / Finish / Close / Got it / Dismiss that matches the outcome.
fail_when: Generic OK, or a name that does not match the outcome (e.g. Dismiss when the task finishes a commit).
guidelines.do_not_claim: `actions.copy.explicit_verb_not_ok` as a merge; Close vs Cancel keep-vs-abandon.

guidelines.title: apply versus save prefer autosave
guidelines.rule: Apply versus Save; prefer autosave; if not, Save + success/error via message bar or confirmation toast.
pass_when: Apply vs Save is used for the right scope; autosave is preferred; without autosave, Save reports success/error via message bar or confirmation toast.
fail_when: Apply/Save mixed up; no autosave and no success/error after Save.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Disabled-until-complete as this row (that lock lives on `govuk.dont-use-disabled-buttons` + `fluent.disabled-field-label-stays-perceivable`); `actions.close_saves_separate_cancel` as a merge.

guidelines.title: ios chrome back done cancel
guidelines.rule: iOS chrome: Back top-left; Done/Save top-right; Cancel top-left when paired with Done/Save, else Cancel top-right.
pass_when: iOS: Back top-left; Done/Save top-right; Cancel top-left when paired with Done/Save, otherwise Cancel top-right.
fail_when: Those controls swapped against that pairing.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A global web OK/Cancel order (`actions.buttons.follow_platform_ok_cancel_order`). Overlap with Actions 40: `follow_platform_ok_cancel_order`.
